Baked here

What comes out of the oven

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Sourdough bread

San Francisco style sourdough, rye, spelt, cranberry walnut and more, with a different bread each day of the week.

Scones and biscuits

Sweet and savoury, like lemon poppyseed, leek and parmesan, or the cheddar jalapeño biscuit, often still warm.

Cheesecake and cakes

New York cheesecake, German chocolate cake, carrot cake, brownies and cookies, from American recipes.

Coffee in the courtyard

Filter coffee, cold brew or Cyprus coffee, to go or at a table in the small courtyard behind the house.

The place

Photos from the Google listing of Fahrenheit Bakery.

Bread by the day

From the weekly bread schedule the bakery posted on Instagram in March 2026.

Tuesday to Thursday

Tuesday rye sourdough and bagels, Wednesday multigrain and San Francisco sourdough, Thursday a special bread and baguettes.

Friday

Stoneground whole wheat sourdough, and focaccia, ready at 12.

Saturday

San Francisco, cranberry walnut, spelt and chocolate cherry sourdough. Guests advise coming early, because things sell out fast.

An old house near Saint Lazarus

Fahrenheit is run by a couple: she is Cypriot and trained as a pastry chef in San Francisco, he is American. They renovated an old Cypriot house on Stadiou, close to the Church of Saint Lazarus, kept its arches and blue shutters, and bake American breads and desserts there. Regulars and visitors from abroad write about it, and many call it the best bakery in Cyprus.

What guests say

Three of 215 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“What a gem! The best baked goods in Larnaca. They have real sourdough bread, their scones are heavenly, the cold brew coffee is high quality and the cozy backyard is perfect for enjoying your pastry. Also, they sell out really fast, so better be early.”

Google review
“A real gem in Larnaka, the atmosphere is warm and friendly, it feels like you are walking into your mothers kitchen while she is baking. The sourdough bread is to die for, authentic and tasty. The owners are super nice and friendly. Prices are fair for the quality of the products. A MUST TRY”

Google review
“Best bread bakery in Larnaca! We’ve been regulars ever since we found this place. The sourdough, baguette, focaccia are so tasty and real. It’s owned and operated by a really nice young couple that are great hosts. Get your bread and some coffee and chill in their outdoor terrace in the back. You won’t regret it!”
